question: What initial practice begins the sequence of yogic signs described to the beloved?
premises: The practice begins with the first stage
The root wheel is the object of practice
The beloved is addressed at the moment of practice
inference: When one first practices the root wheel, the initial stage of signs begins.
uncertainties: The fused form yadānyabhyasate is nonstandard in transmission.
plain_english: O beloved, when one first practices the root wheel.
